        private static KVObject LegacyReadBinaryValue(Context context, KV3BinaryNodeType datatype, KVFlag flagInfo, BinaryReader reader)
        {
            // vpkstuff patch: the legacy reader recursed and counted with no bound: a deep file
            // overflowed the stack (uncatchable), and a typed array of a zero-width type built
            // billions of nodes from four bytes. Same limits as the modern reader.
            if (++context.Depth > 512)
            {
                context.Depth--;
                throw new InvalidDataException("KV3 nesting exceeds 512 levels; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
            }

            // The reader is over the decompressed buffer, whatever the encoding, so its length is
            // the block's real size; the budget is set from it at the root.
            if (context.Nodes == 0)
            {
                context.NodeBudget = Math.Min((1 << 20) + 16L * reader.BaseStream.Length, MaxValues);
            }

            var budget = context.NodeBudget;
            if (++context.Nodes > budget)
            {
                context.Depth--;
                throw new InvalidDataException($"KV3 block holds more than {budget} values; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
            }

            try
            {
                var result = LegacyReadValue(context, datatype, reader);

                if (flagInfo != KVFlag.None)
                {
                    result.Flag = flagInfo;
                }

                return result;
            }
            finally
            {
                context.Depth--;
            }
        }
